retrievalProfile.description: A centered, full-length portrait of a regal figure in a floor-length velvet cape against a flat, saturated red background with repetitive, stacked geometric typography.
triggerTerms: regal velvet cape with fur collar

recipe.visualDefinition: A tall, central figure stands in profile looking back at the viewer, wearing a massive black velvet cape with a white spotted fur collar and a brown fedora. The entire scene is set against a vibrant, flat red studio wall. To the left and right of the figure, columns of text are stacked vertically, partially obscured by the silhouette of the cape, creating a sense of depth and repetition.
coreVisualRelationships: The black silhouette of the cape anchors the composition against the high-chroma red background.
The white fur collar provides a high-contrast focal point near the subject's face.
The repetitive text columns create a rhythmic, wallpaper-like texture behind the subject.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central, full-height figure occupying the middle third of the frame vertically.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the white fur collar at the top-center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the face, moves down the long curve of the cape to the floor, then scans the repetitive text columns on either side.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The red background acts as active negative space, framing the subject and housing the typography.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation background with high value contrast between the black cape and white collar.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Geometric, ultra-rounded sans-serif with uniform stroke weight.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'e' with a horizontal crossbar and circular bowl
Lowercase 'm' and 'n' with perfectly rounded arches

composition.overlap: Partially tucked behind the subject's silhouette

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in different sizes and repetitions for texture.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the geometric, rounded 70s aesthetic perfectly.
Matches the heavy, rounded, monolinear construction.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a man in a brown fedora and a floor-length black velvet cape with a white spotted fur collar against a solid, vibrant red background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Overlay two columns of repetitive, stacked yellow text using a geometric rounded font like Bauhaus, ensuring the text appears to be behind the edges of the black cape.

verificationChecks: Is the background a solid, saturated red?
Does the cape have a distinct white fur collar?
Is the text stacked vertically and partially obscured by the cape?
Is the font geometric and rounded?

mustAchieve: Clean, sharp edges on the cape silhouette

postGenerationChecks: Check for clean masking where text meets the cape.
Ensure the red is vibrant and not muddy.
Verify the fur texture looks realistic and high-contrast.
Confirm the typography is a consistent geometric style.
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject in [Garment] + [Solid High-Chroma Background] + [Stacked Repetitive Geometric Typography] = Retro Soul Aesthetic
